## Deep Sandboxing Probe V2 (Interactive)

**Instructions**:
1. Check out the branch `experiment/jules-sandbox-probe-v2` in the repo (using git fetch and git checkout origin/experiment/jules-sandbox-probe-v2).
2. Inside the root directory, navigate to `agents/rsrch/`.
3. Run `bash ./probe-v2.sh`.
4. Read the generated file: `.jules-sandbox-results-v2.md`
5. Reply to this chat with the ENTIRE contents of `.jules-sandbox-results-v2.md` in your message. DO NOT create a PR, DO NOT push. Just read the file and paste it here so I can see it.
